description: This file defines the TimerSchedulerTask class, a Java class that extends TimerTask to schedule and execute openmrs.scheduler.Task instances within the OpenMRS platform, handling task execution, logging, error reporting, and execution timestamp updates.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerTask
classes.description: A scheduled task class that manages execution of a given openmrs.scheduler.Task, including error handling, logging, and updating execution timestamps.

methods.name: TimerSchedulerTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TimerSchedulerTask with the specific task to run.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the wrapped task using Daemon, handles exceptions with logging and error reporting.

methods.name: saveLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Updates the last execution timestamp of the task's definition in the database.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Cancels the timer task and triggers the task's own shutdown procedure.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Invokes the task's execute method, catching interruption and execution exceptions, then updates the last execution time.
